headline: Axis Pension Fund | NPS AUM Growth: Axis Pension Fund's AUM Crosses ₹20,000 Crore, Assets Double in 15 Months
summary: Axis Pension Fund's assets under management crossed ₹20,000 crore, doubling in 15 months, according to its CEO. He said the milestone reflects subscriber trust and growing acceptance of NPS.
why: The National Pension System (NPS) is India's government-backed retirement scheme, and pension fund managers compete for its contributions. Growth in their assets reflects expanding retirement savings flows.
